scientific_question: Do the PCA full-mode and MPCA full-core endpoints agree numerically with their 2SDR boundary representations, and does an interior row-column-core representation estimate matrix-structured signal more accurately at finite sample size?
claim_boundary: The experiment compares finite-sample estimation inside a structured subfamily. It does not assert that the 2SDR representation family is larger than unrestricted vector PCA.
replicate_seed_derivation: SeedSequence([master_seed, scenario_index, round(snr * 1000000), sample_size, replicate]); the SNR code depends on its numeric value, not its position in the design list
signal_eigenvalues: equal nonzero values normalized so trace(Sigma_signal) / trace(I_192) equals the declared SNR
oracle_interpretation: Oracle refers only to the supplied dimensions p, q, and r. Row, column, and core subspaces are estimated from the paired training scatter.
primary_metric: normalized population prediction risk E||Pi_hat Z - S||^2 / E||S||^2
monte_carlo_summary: Means, sample standard deviations, standard errors, and paired two-sided Student-t 95% intervals over 100 replicates.
structured_efficiency_criterion: For all three SNR values, each of the three interior envelopes at n=250 and n=1000 must have an upper paired 95% interval endpoint below zero for 2SDR minus PCA population prediction risk.
core_reduction_criterion: All three interior envelopes, all three SNR values, and all three sample sizes must have an upper paired 95% interval endpoint below zero for 2SDR minus full-core MPCA population prediction risk.
